context.exploration_scope: Closed the Project Evolution arc (E35..E50) and recorded a transition manifest toward Studio Intelligence Foundation (S0), without designing, modifying, or redesigning the Evolution mechanism, and without creating any real Studio Intelligence structure

problem: Project Evolution had reached independently-reconfirmed stability (E48, E49, E50) but had no formal closing transition recorded pointing to what comes next -- without one, every future phase would have to keep re-deriving "is Evolution still stable" from scratch rather than citing a settled transition point.

decision.decision_summary: Evolution=STABLE (0 new discrepancies vs E40 baseline). Experience=OPERATIONAL (53 records, dangling=0, duplicates=0). Currency=READY. Goal/Capability/Trace/Priority aligned=true. Transition candidate recorded: cand_studio_intelligence_s0_foundation_transition_v1 (not applied). Final state: PROJECT_EVOLUTION_COMPLETE -> STUDIO_INTELLIGENCE_FOUNDATION_READY. 0 real PB/Goal/Gap/LPM/SSI/CHAR modifications, 0 automatic executions.

action.action_summary: Re-verified Goal/Capability/Trace/Priority/Experience consistency and Evolution Trigger/Drift against the fixed E40 baseline without any mechanism redesign; recorded exactly 1 candidate-only Studio Intelligence Foundation (S0) transition proposal; wrote the closing transition manifest.

evidence.evidence_detail: evolution_stable=true, experience_consistent=true, currency_ready=true, regression_all_passed=true, final_state=PROJECT_EVOLUTION_COMPLETE -> STUDIO_INTELLIGENCE_FOUNDATION_READY

result.note: Project Evolution closed cleanly with a real, grounded transition candidate; no Studio Intelligence structure was built, only proposed.

cause.root_cause_summary: A long-running verification arc (E35..E50) needs an explicit closing transition, not an implicit trailing-off, so later phases have one settled reference point instead of re-deriving stability from scratch.

lesson: Closing an arc and opening the next one are two different actions that must not be conflated: this phase confirmed closure with real, independently-rechecked data, and proposed the next arc only as a candidate, never as a structural fait accompli.
